response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS n FROM orders o JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.ordertune IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS m FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.n) AS avg_count_above_average, AVG(c.n - a.m) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM c, a WHERE c.n > a.m;

assumptions.assumption: Each order is counted once (distinct orders), even if it has several risk/margin records.
Only order types with at least one matched order appear. The average across types is taken over those types.
Orders with a NULL ordertune are not treated as a type and are excluded.
